uncommitted.sourceLine: At September 30, 2026 , the Company had no outstanding borrowings and approximately $ 745 million of additional borrowing capacity (after taking into consideration the $ 32 million of outstanding letters of credit) under the ABL Facility.

maturities.sourceLine: The 6⅞% Senior Notes due 2028 are scheduled to mature on April 1, 2028 .

The 6% Senior Secured Notes due 2029, which mature on January 15, 2029 , bear interest at a rate of 6% per year payable semi-annually in arrears on January 15 and July 15 of each year, commencing on July 15, 2021.
The 5¼% Senior Secured Notes due 2030 bear interest at a rate of 5.250 % per year payable semi-annually in arrears on May 15 and November 15, commencing on November 15, 2022.
The 4¾% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 bear interest at a rate of 4.750% per year payable semi-annually in arrears on February 15 and August 15, commencing on August 15, 2021.
The 10⅞ % Senior Secured Notes due 2032 bear interest at a rate of 10.875 % per year payable semi-annually in arrears on February 15 and August 15, commencing on August 15, 2024 .
The 10¾ % Senior Secured Notes due 2033 bear interest at a rate of 10.750 % per year payable semi-annually in arrears on June 15 and December 15 of each year, commencing on December 15, 2025.
The 9¾ % Senior Secured Notes due 2034 bear interest at a rate of 9.750 % per year payable semi-annually in arrears on March 15 and September 15 of each year, commencing on March 15, 2026.
The 6⅞ % Junior-Priority Secured Notes due 2029 bear interest at a rate of 6.875 % per year payable semi-annually in arrears on April 15 and October 15 of each year, commencing on October 15, 2021.
The 6⅛ % Junior-Priority Secured Notes due 2030 bear interest at a rate of 6.125 % per year payable semi-annually in arrears on May 15 and November 15 of each year, commencing on November 15, 2021.
Principal amounts outstanding under the ABL Facility will be due and payable in full on June 5, 2029.

price.value: 103 % of the principal amount, plus accrued and unpaid interest
price.sourceLine: On February 2, 2026, the Company exercised a special call provision to redeem 10 % of the original principal amount, or approximately $ 223 million, of the 10.875 % Senior Secured Notes due 2032 , at a redemption price of 103 % of the principal amount, plus accrued and unpaid interest.
